title: Yellow Smoky Argentinian Lamb Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew featuring makrut lime leaves and smoky undertones, perfect for a cozy dinner. This dish is macrobiotic-friendly and offers a unique blend of floral and savory notes.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the smoked paprika, makrut lime leaves, and chicken broth, stirring to combine.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1.5 hours.
Add the chopped yellow bell pepper and continue to simmer, uncovered, for an additional 30 minutes.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste, then serve hot.
